what_this_is: How read-data/draw-an-email.mjs draws an email in a look. `palette_roles`, `font_roles`, `radius_roles` and `button_roles` name the look variables each part of the email wears (the email's ink, accent, paper, faces, corners and button depth). `shipped_palette` is the look an email is drawn in when the account has published none: the starting look's variables for those roles, resolved by the screen-look resolver (tools/screen-looks/read-data/resolve-screen-look-palette.js). The mark at the email's top and its `made_with` line are the account's own, from its mail row (`brand`, `made_with`); with none, the top carries no mark and there is no made-with line. Moved from the older owner's mail settings (palette_roles, font_roles, radius_roles, button_roles) and its starting look. `looks` are the looks an account can wear (its `start_with` and `themes`), from the older owner's src/workspace/looks.json: the app DATA do-work/read-the-worn-email-look.mjs hands tools/screen-looks/do-work/read-current-worn-look.mjs, so the look the person wears (one of these or their own, from their records) is the look every email is drawn in; `shipped_palette` is `start_with` resolved.

shipped_palette.--font-primary: SF Pro Text, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

brand_unread: The look this email is drawn in could not be read, so it was not sent. Try again shortly.
